newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK UNIT TO BUILD FIM 70 MLN LIME KILN.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK UNIT TO BUILD FIM 70 MLN LIME KILN.

text.p: Finnish building materials and engineering group Partek Oy Ab said in a statement on Friday its Nordkalk unit would invest 70 million markka in a new lime kiln at its Tytyri lime plant at Lohja in southern Finland.
"The investment will increase Nordkalk's production capacity of quick lime by 140,000 tonnes per year, raising the entire capacity to more than a million tonnes a year," Partek said.
The investment will continue Nordkalk's growth strategy, Partek said, adding the new lime kiln would strengthen the unit's competitive position.
Nordkalk delivers quick lime mainly to the steel, pulp and chemical industries and for environmental conservation.

Partek said Nordkalk is the leading producer of limestone-based products in the Baltic region. The unit's annual net sales total about one billion markka with quick lime accounting for about one third. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
